title: Lovely Mustardy Norwegian Bread Flatbread
description: A crunchy and energizing Norwegian bread flatbread dish that is rich in mustardy flavor and anti-inflammatory properties.
instructions: Combine rye flour, sugar, and salt in a large mixing bowl.
Gradually pour in water while stirring with a wooden spoon until a sticky dough forms.
Cover the dough with plastic wrap and let it rest at room temperature for 24 hours.
After resting, add dried mustard and sesame seeds, and mix well.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Shape the dough into a ball and flatten it slightly into a disk.
Place the dough in a clay pot or a heat-resistant bowl and cover with a lid.
Cook the flatbread over low heat in a preheated oven at 375°F for 30 minutes.
Remove the lid and brush the top with olive oil.
Return the flatbread to the oven and bake for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the flatbread from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before slicing.
